ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms reproduction steps, ranked hypotheses and the change-before-reproduction flag are declared; it does not show the bug is reproducible.
offer: Capture a repeatable failure before changing code and rank hypotheses from evidence. One experiment should separate explanations; speculative fixes before reproduction erase useful evidence.

minimal.reason: Write the steps that reproduce the failure. A fix made without a repeatable failure erases evidence, so capture the commands and input first.

mid.reason: Rank the hypotheses by evidence, each with the experiment that separates it. An unranked list invites guessing, so order them and name the discriminating test.

maximal.reason: Set change before reproduction to false. Editing code before the failure reproduces destroys the evidence, so reproduce first.
